events.title: International Flavors (IFF) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
events.body: International Flavors (IFF) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +16.01% and +3.44%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
